As of March 2024, Keutsch has stepped back from SCoPEx, and the platform will be redirected towards unrelated stratospheric research. This shift underscores the necessity for careful discourse on geoengineering, highlighting the importance of climate justice and emissions reduction over untested interventions. The uncertainties surrounding ozone chemistry, stratospheric heating, and ecological impacts must remain at the forefront of discussions. #ozone #biodiversity #airpollution #environment #geoengineering
